entities.summary: The St. Nicholas Cathedral also called Tumbes Cathedral Or Church of San Nicolás de Tolentino is the name that receives a temple affiliated and property of the Catholic Church located in the locality of Tumbes in the department of the same name to the north of the South American country of Peru.
